series.name: Pleasantville
series.description: Pleasantville is a wholesome place with a variety of interesting creatures. Visitors often describe it as a community rather than a city for a reason. Everyone there is friendly, tolerant, and kind.

series.name: Strange Animals
series.description: Strange Animals is an anthology of horror novels written by Tiago Sousa. The writing is similar to The Twilight Zone; it always contains a supernatural element (the strange 'animal') and explores adult concepts through violence, suspense, and mystery.
